blessings.name: Enveloping Winds
blessings.description: Windburst deals 10% more damage for every enemy hit.

blessings.name: Updraft
blessings.description: Windburst has a 10% chance to leave behind an Updraft. Updraft temporarily increases your Fire Rate by 20%.

blessings.name: Whirling Winds
blessings.description: Windburst has a 20% chance to pull enemies in.
blessings.unmodeled: no numeric damage effect the DSL can express

blessings.name: Culling Winds
blessings.description: Windburst deals 4% more damage for every 10% of health that the enemy is missing.

blessings.name: Propelling Wind
blessings.description: Windburst has a 25% chance of sending a small gust of wind toward a nearby enemy. Deals 100 Weakspot damage and increases by 25 per Wind Blessing.
blessings.unmodeled: no numeric damage effect the DSL can express

blessings.name: Headwind
blessings.description: Windburst Slows enemies for 3 seconds. The enemies' projectiles are Slowed by 50% and deal 25% less damage.

blessings.name: Eye of the Storm
blessings.description: Windburst deals up to 25% additional damage the closer the enemies are to the middle of the Windburst.

blessings.name: Destructive Winds
blessings.description: Windbursts deal 40% additional area damage but their area size is reduced by 40%.
blessings.unmodeled: no numeric damage effect the DSL can express

blessings.name: Ramping Winds
blessings.description: Enemies that die within 1 sec. of being hit by a Windburst create an additional Windburst.
blessings.unmodeled: no numeric damage effect the DSL can express

blessings.name: Raging Storm
blessings.description: Windburst damage now scales with 100% of its area of effect size.
blessings.unmodeled: no numeric damage effect the DSL can express

blessings.description: Windburst deals 10% more damage each time it triggers on the same enemy. Up to 5 times.

blessings.name: Storm Caller
blessings.description: Windbursts that trigger from Weakspots have a 30% increased radius.
blessings.unmodeled: no numeric damage effect the DSL can express

blessings.name: Lifting Winds
blessings.description: Windbursts have a 20% chance to launch enemies into the air. Launched enemies are Stunned and take 50% of the Windburst's damage when they land.
blessings.unmodeled: no numeric damage effect the DSL can express

blessings.name: Squall
blessings.description: Windburst radius has a 20% chance to increase by 30%.

blessings.name: Wind's Devastation
blessings.description: Every Wind Blessing increases the size of all areas of effect by 5%.
